mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_reconciliation_job (order_id, operation, status, retry_count, max_retries, next_attempt_at, payment_key, version, created_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{operation}, 'PENDING', 0, #{maxRetries}, COALESCE(#{nextAttemptAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, now()), #{paymentKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, now()) ON CONFLICT (order_id, operation) WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT job_id, order_id, operation, status, retry_count, max_retries, next_attempt_at, locked_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at, payment_key, version FROM payment_reconciliation_job WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') AND next_attempt_at <= now() AND (locked_at IS NULL OR locked_at < now() - INTERVAL '5 minutes') ORDER BY next_attempt_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_reconciliation_job SET status = 'FAILED', last_error = #{lastError}, locked_at = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE payment_reconciliation_job SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, locked_at = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND version = #{version}
